worlds.name: The Promise of the Spirit
worlds.story: Jesus promises the Holy Spirit and is taken up into heaven.

worlds.name: A New Apostle
worlds.story: The disciples pray together and Matthias is chosen.

worlds.name: The Day of Pentecost
worlds.story: A rushing wind, tongues of fire, and many languages.

worlds.name: Peter's Great Sermon
worlds.story: Peter explains Joel's prophecy and preaches Jesus.

worlds.name: The First Church
worlds.story: Three thousand are baptized and the believers share everything.

worlds.name: The Beautiful Gate
worlds.story: A lame man walks and Peter preaches at Solomon's Porch.

worlds.name: Arrested for Jesus
worlds.story: Peter and John stand boldly before the council.

worlds.name: Praying for Boldness
worlds.story: The place is shaken and the believers share all they have.

worlds.name: Ananias and Sapphira
worlds.story: A lie to the Holy Spirit, and many signs and wonders.

worlds.name: Out of Prison
worlds.story: An angel opens the prison and Gamaliel gives advice.

worlds.name: Seven Chosen Helpers
worlds.story: Seven men are chosen and Stephen is accused.

worlds.name: Stephen Tells the Story
worlds.story: Stephen begins with God's call to Abraham.

worlds.name: Joseph and the Patriarchs
worlds.story: Joseph is sold into Egypt and God is with him.

worlds.name: Moses Is Born
worlds.story: Moses grows up in Pharaoh's house and flees to Midian.

worlds.name: The Burning Bush
worlds.story: God calls Moses, and Israel turns away in the wilderness.

worlds.name: Stephen the Brave
worlds.story: Stephen sees heaven opened and forgives as he dies.

worlds.name: Philip in Samaria
worlds.story: Philip preaches in Samaria and Simon the sorcerer believes.

worlds.name: The Ethiopian on the Road
worlds.story: Philip explains Isaiah to the Ethiopian official.

worlds.name: Light on the Damascus Road
worlds.story: A light from heaven stops Saul on the road.

worlds.name: Darkness in Damascus
worlds.story: Saul is blind in Damascus. Ananias is sent by the Lord.

worlds.name: Escape Over the Wall
worlds.story: Saul preaches, escapes in a basket and meets Barnabas.

worlds.name: Miracles of Peter
worlds.story: Peter heals Aeneas in Lydda and raises Dorcas in Joppa.

worlds.name: Two Visions
worlds.story: Cornelius sees an angel. Peter sees a great sheet from heaven.

worlds.name: The Good News for All
worlds.story: Peter preaches at Cornelius's house and the Holy Spirit falls on the Gentiles.

worlds.name: Peter's Report
worlds.story: Peter explains everything to the believers in Jerusalem.

worlds.name: Christians in Antioch
worlds.story: The church grows in Antioch and the disciples are first called Christians.

worlds.name: Peter's Prison Escape
worlds.story: An angel leads Peter out while the church prays.

worlds.name: Herod's Fall
worlds.story: Herod does not give glory to God, but the word grows.

worlds.name: Sent Out by the Spirit
worlds.story: Barnabas and Saul are sent out; the sorcerer is blinded.

worlds.name: Paul Preaches in Antioch
worlds.story: Paul tells Israel's story and preaches Jesus in the synagogue.

worlds.name: A Light to the Gentiles
worlds.story: The Gentiles rejoice and the disciples shake off the dust.

worlds.name: Trouble in Iconium
worlds.story: Paul and Barnabas flee to Lystra and meet a crippled man.

worlds.name: Gods in Lystra?
worlds.story: The crowd calls Paul and Barnabas gods, then Paul is stoned.

worlds.name: Strengthening the Churches
worlds.story: Elders are appointed and the missionaries return to Antioch.

worlds.name: The Jerusalem Council
worlds.story: The apostles and elders decide about the Gentiles.

worlds.name: The Letter to the Gentiles
worlds.story: A letter is sent, and Paul and Barnabas part ways.

worlds.name: The Macedonian Call
worlds.story: Timothy joins Paul, a vision calls them to Macedonia, and Lydia believes.

worlds.name: Midnight in Philippi
worlds.story: Paul and Silas sing in prison and the jailer is saved.

bosses.name: The Shadow Golem
bosses.taunt: You will forget everything in the dark!

bosses.name: The Gloom Dragon
bosses.taunt: My gloom will cover your memory!

bosses.name: The Storm Kraken
bosses.taunt: My storm will blow your answers away!

bosses.name: The Doubt Giant
bosses.taunt: You doubt yourself... you will fail!

bosses.name: The Fog Phantom
bosses.taunt: In my fog, every verse disappears!
